declarations.description:
A group of card actions. NAME PROVISIONAL (Technical Writer).

Where it sits decides its rules (from its `slot`):
- `slot="header"`: up to two ghost `prism-icon-button`s, or one overflow
  `prism-menu`. No text buttons. On a narrow card the icon buttons fold into
  one overflow menu († narrow rule: page says "about 280px or less").
- `slot="footer"`: up to two `prism-button`s, ghost or secondary (soft),
  plus one primary only on a `standalone` card. A "View all" link counts as
  one. Medium size, 8px apart, at the end (mirrors in right-to-left).
- no slot (content-only card): the last row of the content, at the end,
  medium size, 8px apart, ghost and secondary only. Soft goes on the right,
  ghost to its left (put the ghost button first in the DOM). The row wraps
  to the next line on the end side and sits at the bottom of the card.

Invalid children are hidden with a dev error.
declarations.name: PrismCardActions

Unslotted children go to `content`, which is free. ```html Phishing playbook Owner: SOC

Free content.

Updated 2 min ago View all ``` Accessibility: the card has no role of its own beyond `group` (standalone), `listitem` (inside `prism-card-list`) or none (inside an `li`). declarations.name: stateLayer
declarations.description:
Private shared state layer for ANY interactive surface: buttons, options,
tree rows, list items, tabs, clickable cards, icon buttons.

Contract (theme-facing, set from outside via ::part()):
  --_bg   resting fill (may be `transparent`); never changes with state
  --_on   text/icon colour on that fill
  --_bg-hover / --_bg-pressed / --_bg-selected   optional fixed fills, used
          ONLY when color-mix() is unsupported (Safari < 16.2 etc.)

Alpha overlay (Astryx-style): background-color stays var(--_bg); each state
paints background-image: linear-gradient(X, X) with
  X = color-mix(in srgb, var(--_on) N%, transparent)
i.e. the element's own text colour at N% alpha composited over its fill.
The resolved overlay colour is exposed as --_prism-state-overlay.
The overlay paints under a transparent border too (background-clip:
border-box), so a border that should follow the fill uses `transparent`.

States (in the shadow root, so ::part() themes don't need per-state rules):
  hover     8%  :hover inside

Private base for the text input family (TextInput, PasswordInput,
SearchInput, OtpInput, TextArea). Owns form association, value/reset/
restore, validity mirroring and the label/description/error chrome. Each
public component only renders its own control via `renderControl()`; there
is no type switch here. Not exported from the package.
declarations.name: TextControl

autocapitalize are off so a revealed value isn't sent to spelling

declarations.description:
A multi-line text input. `autosize` grows it with its content (from
`rows`). With `maxlength` and `counter`, shows "n / max"; the visible
counter is aria-hidden and a polite live region announces only when the
remaining count gets low (≤ 10% or ≤ 20) and at the limit, debounced, so
typing isn't drowned in announcements.
declarations.name: PrismTextArea
